preregistration.expectation: A fresh venv synced from requirements.lock plus duckdb==1.5.5 runs promotion_gate.py on duckdb://<file>#snapshot inputs built from good.csv and bad.csv. Expected: the pandas-registered table reproduces good-gate-result.json and bad-gate-result.json (same status, row_count and per-check status). A DuckDB-native read_csv auto-typed table (DATE/TIMESTAMP/BIGINT) may differ; that difference is a finding to record, not hidden. Then duckdb is added to requirements.in and the lock regenerated with the old lock as constraints so no other pin moves.
preregistration.criteria: settled iff: the pandas-registered duckdb inputs match both fixtures on status, row_count and every named check's status; the regenerated lock differs from the old one only by the added duckdb entry; a fresh venv syncs from the new lock with --require-hashes; and the unit suite passes with PROMOTION_GATE_PYTHON pointed at that venv and REQUIRE_PROMOTION_GATE_VENV=1, including a new duckdb-path test. Any auto-typed mismatch is reported. Detection: the comparison is per-check and would report any differing check.
